reports.title: Immunome Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

desk.headline: Net loss widens to $85.8m ($0.76/share), worse than estimates; cash $462m, runway into 2028; FDA decision on varegacestat due 28 Apr 2027
results: No revenue yet; the net loss widened to $85.8m, or $0.76 a share, against an estimate of about $0.60.
R&D spending rose to $69.5m and admin costs almost doubled to $20.9m as the company prepares for a possible launch.
Cash and marketable securities were $461.6m at quarter end, down from $653.5m at the end of 2025.
Varegacestat (desmoid tumours) has an FDA decision date of 28 Apr 2027, and the EU regulator validated its filing in October.
IM-1340 got clearance to start human trials, with a Phase 1 start planned by year-end.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance beyond cash runway: Immunome expects current cash to fund operations into 2028. Milestones: updated IM-1021 lymphoma data at ASH on 14 Dec 2026, an IM-1340 trial start and an IM-1335 filing by late 2026.

points: The CEO stressed progress toward approval and launch of varegacestat.
Three programmes are in clinical trials, with IM-1340 expected to be the fourth by year-end.
Updated Phase 1 data for IM-1021, a ROR1-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, will be shown at ASH in December.
call.source: No call coverage found; points from CEO comments in the results release
